blocks.text: LUCENA CITY, QUEZON, Philippines — Despite the failure of the United States and the Philippines to sign an agreement on the controversial Pax Silica alliance during US President Donald Trump’s recent visit, a national peasant organization urged Filipinos to sustain and intensify their protest campaign against the initiative. “There is no respite. A more intensified campaign is in order. Pax Silica is still around, waiting to be signed,” Jansept Geronimo, national spokesperson of the Kilusan para sa Repormang Agraryo at Katarungang Panlipunan (Katarungan), said in a phone interview Thursday.
